comment: Regression gate thresholds (Phase 8). Gate FAILS when a fresh deterministic eval drops any metric below its floor, or scores fewer answerable cases than this baseline. BASELINE = 2026-11-09 18:59 re-baseline on the CURRENT committed pipeline (60c07e4) + current KB (weapon-stat rebuild). The earlier 14:45 report (cov .640) was produced by a transient uncommitted working-tree state that no longer exists; the committed pipeline reproduces 0.551 byte-identically across runs (determinism verified x3, hash-seed-independent). Floors = re-baseline minus 0.03 patch-day tolerance.
